name: Firecrawl
description: Turn any web page into clean Markdown, map a site's links, or crawl a site depth-limited — with a live spider console that shows every fetch, refusal and failure as it happens.
tab.label: Crawler
action.openConsole.label: Crawler console
prompt.console.instructions: The Firecrawl crawler console is open in the activity panel. Use firecrawl_scrape for a single page (it renders JavaScript in the host browser when the static HTML is an app shell, and parses PDFs), firecrawl_map to discover URLs, firecrawl_crawl for several pages, firecrawl_search when the user wants the web searched first, and firecrawl_extract when they want structured data out of one or more pages. Keep the defaults unless the user asks for more, and say which rule refused the links you skipped.

spider.aria: Radial map of the crawl: the start page at the center, each ring one link hop further out. Filled dots are fetched pages, dashed spokes are links that were refused.
